name: App specific tokens

subjectOf.text: Sixty of the top 100 tokens allow or intend inter-system functionality, while thirty-two are fundamentally restricted to use within a given ecosystem.
subjectOf.abstract: Sixty tokens allow or intend inter-system functionality, while thirty-two tokens are fundamentally restricted for use in a given ecosystem.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860

subjectOf.text: App-specific tokens exert less influence over value from other projects and typically fail to support a broader user market, because their limited use curtails user access.
subjectOf.abstract: App-specific tokens generally can exert less influence over the value from other projects. App-specific tokens also typically do not allow for a broader user market as the limited use of the token curtails user access.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860
